scope: Corollary 4.6 (Cost of changing a calibration state) of the manuscript “Uniform Stability of the Spherical Laughlin Gap” (preprints/Uniform-Stability-of-the-Spherical-Laughlin-Gap-October-5-2026/uniform-stability-spherical-laughlin-gap.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 269 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1bb20744f2bfa51), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let q0 = 3⌊q/3⌋ and r = q − q0 ∈ {0, 1, 2}. Consider the interaction Kq,3(f) on Fq−3 and its common-frame comparison with Kq0,3(f). Embed a unit vector ξ ∈ Zn,q0−3 by the common orbital labels, or instead grow it to flux q − 3 using the r isometries UQ,1. The following costs are each bounded by C Z q−3 0 Aq(m) v(m) dm : (4.21) the change of interaction in the embedded state, and the change of its expectation between the embedded and grown states. The same bounds hold after selecting any common collection of source-center pieces, and after adding their absolute bounds. In particular the statement applies to the filled vector at flux q0 − 3 and to separate northern and southern portions of the interaction.
